final.final_answer:
From the official World Bank API response at the provided URL for indicator SP.POP.TOTL (Population, total) for India (IND), Brazil (BRA), and Nigeria (NGA) over 2020–2026, the latest year in which all three countries have non-null population values is 2025.

Exact 2025 population values (from the API):
- India (IND): 1,433,350,970
- Brazil (BRA): 212,812,405
- Nigeria (NGA): 229,152,217

Ranking from highest to lowest population in that common year (2025):
1) India – 1,433,350,970
2) Nigeria – 229,152,217
3) Brazil – 212,812,405
